title: Time-Updated Prognostic Modeling in ICU Patients with Documented Coma or Unresponsiveness Using Routine Arterial Blood Gas Trajectories: An Exploratory Explainable Machine-Learning Study.
summary: Time-updated logistic-regression models used admission, 24-hour and 72-hour ABG/SpO2 trajectories to estimate ICU death in 108 patients with documented coma or unresponsiveness. The study reports internal cross-validation and bootstrap intervals; respiratory-support confounding and missingness mean this is exploratory ICU-course prognosis, not admission-only prediction.
ai_technology: Staged ML models on admission variables and ABG/SpO2 trajectory features at 24/72h; 108 single-center ICU patients, 71 deaths. Internal validation, bootstrap intervals, sensitivity analyses. Primary no-respiratory-support logistic models AUC 0.822/0.848/0.895; 72-hour availability and ICU severity limit interpretation.
